g.text: Manual escalation, not part of the automated flow above: if validation resolved
UNAVAILABLE (the validation tooling itself was unreachable, not a data defect),
the Office Manager may still send with an audited override reason — the pre-existing
FinalizationGate override, reusing the already-COMPLETED job's document; the
same call the Invoice Lifecycle State Machine's IN_REVIEW -> SENT edge always
used before this feature. INVALID/PENDING/NOT_VALIDATED remain non-overridable.
